title: RT readiness state machine + per-frame pipeline/descriptor selection
purpose: Pick the correct pipeline (with/without shell) and push only valid descriptors, based on TLAS readiness signaled on GPU timelines.

steps.detail: Add a small struct in VolumeRenderer to track shellBuildSubmitted, shellBLASReady, shellTLASReady (timeline values).
MeshParticleRenderer queries this state each frame; if shellTLASReady < expected, it selects pipeline_ext and omits binding 4.
Throttled logs print selected pipeline and descriptors pushed: 'pipeline=ext|ext+shell, descriptors=2|3'.

acceptance: No draws use statically referenced but unbound binding 4
Descriptor push count matches selected pipeline
Overlay shows when shells become active
